settings.heading: Our 30-day return policy
settings.subheading: Changed your mind? You've got a full month.
settings.highlight_text: 30 days to request a return from when you receive your order
settings.eligibility_text: To be eligible for a return, your stool must be in the condition you received it — unused and in its original packaging — within 30 days of delivery. You'll also need your order number or proof of purchase.
settings.how_text: Email us at s77506910@gmail.com to request a return, and we'll reply with the return address and simple instructions. You cover the return postage for change-of-mind returns — we refund the full price you paid as soon as it arrives back. Please don't post anything without emailing first, or we may not be able to match it to your order.
settings.damages_text: If your stool arrives damaged, faulty, or isn't what you ordered, that's entirely on us. Email a photo and your order number, and choose: a full refund including any postage, or a free replacement shipped at our cost. No quibbling.
settings.exceptions_text: Bulk and masjid orders are arranged individually — email us and we'll sort any issue directly. Nothing else is excluded: if you bought it on this site, the 30-day promise applies.
settings.eu_text: Nothing in this policy limits your statutory rights under UK consumer law — including your rights when goods are faulty and the 14-day cooling-off period for online purchases.
settings.refund_text: We'll notify you once we've received and inspected your return, and let you know if it's approved. If approved, you'll be automatically refunded on your original payment method within 10 business days. It can take extra time for your bank or card provider to post the refund.
settings.footer_text: Questions about a return? Email s77506910@gmail.com and a person will help sort it out.

settings.question: Is it valid to pray sitting on this?
settings.answer: When standing or kneeling is genuinely difficult, praying seated is fully valid — the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم instructed: “Pray standing; if you are not able, then sitting; and if you are not able, then on your side” (Sahih al-Bukhari). For your own situation, your local imam can advise properly.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Free tracked UK delivery on every order. We dispatch within 1–3 working days and delivery usually takes 4–7 once shipped — so most orders arrive within 7–10 working days of ordering. A small number take a little longer (up to 14) if customs or busy periods slow things down; your tracking link always shows exactly where it is.

settings.question: Who pays for return postage?
settings.answer: For change-of-mind returns, you cover the return postage and we refund the full price you paid. If the stool arrives damaged or faulty, we cover everything — full refund including postage, or a free replacement, your choice.

settings.question: Can we order for a masjid?
settings.answer: Yes — and we'd be honoured. Email s77506910@gmail.com with roughly how many you need and we'll sort a fair bulk price and a proper invoice.
